question: OC is the bisector of \(\angle AOB\). Which of the following conclusions is incorrect?
solution: An angle bisector divides an angle into two equal parts, so \(\angle AOC=\angle BOC=\frac{1}{2}\angle AOB\) and \(\angle AOB=2\angle BOC\). The statement \(\angle AOC=2\angle AOB\) is incorrect.
